verdict.rationale: Docs claim easy deployment without complex configuration or dependencies, single-binary setup, broad OS/architecture and DB support, and community hands-on reports strongly corroborate this — single-binary installs, simple upgrades, low resource usage compared to GitLab. Minor gaps exist (some users note poor migration/backup docs and occasional friction), but the core self-hosting ease-of-setup story is well supported. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of install time, more detail on backup/restore ease which some users flagged as lacking.
